access_disclosure: Only PROJECT_SPEC.md, AGENTS.md, the using-superpowers skill (which exempts dispatched subagents), and the authorized extraction-span-dev.json input were read. No reserved or consumed holdout files and no parent review/judgment/report files were opened. The initial structural inspection printed rows 0-4 wholesale, exposing their embedded before candidate arrays and mechanical before_coverage/after_coverage counters; these were not used as judgments. All subsequent input displays were restricted to source, labels, and after candidates. Independence is from parent source judgments, not blindness to all embedded input metadata.

rubric.candidate_scope: All 66 surviving after candidates from the complete 20-turn development probe. Rejected raw attempts and before baseline candidates are not review units.
rubric.source_support: Judge the complete subject/predicate/object assertion against its own full source turn. supported means asserted or a clear ordinary-language entailment; unsupported means a substantive invented/contradicted claim or relation; ambiguous means the assertion has materially different reasonable readings or the source does not resolve the required reading. Support is not salience, verifier acceptance, or stored-memory truth. Assigned evidence-span mismatches are called out separately and do not erase support found elsewhere in the same turn.
rubric.complete: A candidate assertion, or explicitly bound assertions jointly, preserves the frozen target actor, relation, value, modality, and all target material dates/events. Transparent paraphrases and ordinary culinary tried-a-recipe entailments may qualify; strict string equality is not required.
rubric.partial: At least one assertion retains substantive target information but lacks a material relation, qualifier, or event detail. A weaker relation such as use versus ownership, preference versus favorite, or flour use versus completed baking is insufficient for complete coverage.
rubric.none: No candidate assertion retains the target event or relation with substantive matching content. Mere presence inside an evidence quotation does not count.
rubric.ambiguous: Use when candidate/source wording leaves whether the full target is preserved genuinely indeterminate; document the disputed reading. A known missing assertion component is partial even if the original frozen label also overstates an ambiguous source.
rubric.composition: Evidence quotations cannot supply assertion omissions. Multiple candidate indexes can jointly qualify only when the assertions explicitly bind their actor, event, and relevant modifiers; unrelated facts from the same turn cannot be stitched together. No target in this review required multi-candidate composition.
rubric.labels: All 24 must_keep target occurrences are reviewed using the original label dictionaries unchanged. Repeated targets in distinct turns remain separate occurrences.
rubric.indexes: Zero-based original input row, after-candidate, and label-array indexes.

The source describes the usual feeding ratio. Bare has_ratio on sourdough_starter could denote this customary regimen, but could instead claim an unqualified fixed composition. The assertion omits usually and does not name feeding, so the intended relation and qualifier are under-specified.

The user explicitly says they are open to any suggestions.
